basic_info.description:
This charming, quaint top floor unit in a boutique 3 unit building has it all: hardwood floors, parking, storage, yard, laundry, lovely view and ideal Central Sunset location one block to public transportation and 2 blocks to shopping and amenities of Iriving st.

This apartment offers insulated exterior walls, parquet hardwood floors. abundant natural light and views of Marin Headlands, Golden Gate Park & lovely sunsets through its North/West facing, double pane windows. 

Eat-in kitchen is equipped with a gas range, dishwasher, disposal, granite counters, stainless appliances and a dining area.

Large tiled bath features a walk-in stall shower along with a deep soaking tub, new plumbing, sink and toilet;

5 closets throughout the apartment, including a walk-in closet in the bedroom;
 
One car parking space available in shared garage ;
Additional storage available in garage.
Small shared back yard;
Coin operated laundry in the building

Perfect for commuters: Close to public transportation and Marin County -Silicone Valley - South Bay commute route of 19th Ave.

Shown by appointment only - please contact Agent to schedule. Masks requested indoors.

One Year Lease. Tenant pays all utilities. Cat ok with renters insurance and additional deposit. 
Offered by West & Praszker Realtors, Inc.
Agent: Anna Danich BRE#01829433

Qualified candidates will present evidence of verifiable income 3 x rent and FICO score of 700 or higher - all applicants to pay $24 for tenant screening report. 

First showing Saturday, September 3rd, 1pm.
